phases.name: Femoral Site Healing & Rhythm Monitoring
phases.clinical_note: Groin puncture care, rhythm stabilization (blanking period precautions)

advance_criteria.description: Groin healed, rhythm stable without sustained arrhythmia

meals.name: Anti-Inflammatory Breakfast
meals.notes: Berry smoothie or oatmeal with chia seeds

meals.name: Light Restorative Dinner
meals.notes: Steamed fish or tofu with leafy greens

instructions: No heavy lifting > 10 lbs or squatting for 5 days
Avoid submersion baths until groin site is fully closed

checks.name: Groin Puncture Site
checks.target: Check femoral access for swelling, firmness, or bleeding

checks.name: Pulse Rhythm & Rate
checks.target: Check pulse regularly; report runs of rapid beats

templates.focus_note: Allow the groin access sites to seal securely and monitor heart rhythm closely.
